description:
Brand Introduction: Welcome to Transfer Gang, your one-stop solution for custom DTF heat transfers and DTF gang sheets. We specialize in providing high-quality, customizable heat transfers that cater to your unique needs. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, Transfer Gang is your trusted partner in bringing your designs to life.

Product Description: At Transfer Gang, we offer the highest quality custom DTF heat transfers and DTF gang sheets. Our products are designed to suit a variety of applications, from apparel and accessories to promotional items. With meticulous attention to detail, we ensure that each transfer captures the essence of your design, providing vibrant colors and durable prints that stand the test of time.

USP (Unique Selling Point): What sets Transfer Gang apart is our dedication to customer satisfaction. We offer perforated cutting services for our valued large volume customers, streamlining the process and making application a breeze. One of our key USPs is the elimination of art fees – we believe in transparency and simplicity, ensuring that your experience with us is not only seamless but also cost-effective.

Payment Terms: Our payment terms are designed to reward our affiliates for their efforts. Affiliates receive a competitive 10% commission on every successful referral they make. Payments are processed at the end of each month, ensuring that your hard work translates into tangible rewards without delay.

Other Information: At Transfer Gang, we believe in fostering strong partnerships. Our affiliate program goes beyond just financial incentives – it's about joining a community dedicated to delivering top-notch custom heat transfers to clients worldwide. With a user-friendly interface, detailed tracking, and dedicated support, our affiliate program is built to empower you every step of the way.

Ready to take the next step and Join The Gang? Join us in revolutionizing the custom heat transfer industry and earning rewards while doing so.
name: Transfer Gang
